QuestInfo.name: The Revival of the Arans
QuestInfo.0: The Arans! They are going to revive. But who are the Arans? And why did they disappear from Maple World? Talk to #bCassandra#k if you'd like to find out more about them.
QuestInfo.1: Cassandra seems to know a lot about them...
QuestInfo.2: The 12 Aran Memory Fragments? Perhaps you should go see Cassandra to find the Aran Memory Fragments.
